scope: Current live homepage footer brand/contact group at 320, 390, 768 and 1440px. Group screenshots isolate contacts; companion viewport screenshots retain page context.

findings.issue: Email and phone are adjacent inline-block anchors without separating gap or row structure; their visible text joins into one string. The phone SVG sits on a separate line above the number.
findings.evidence: Email ends exactly where phone begins at each width (for mobile, x20 + 186.5px = phone x206.5). Phone anchor is 55.39px high compared with email 44px.

findings.issue: Current visible logo is lowercase yo. with App Academy, while title and footer company text identify YO Tech Academy / YO Tech LLC.
findings.evidence: Captured DOM title, headerBrand, brand and footerText.

recommendation: Keep contacts in a compact stacked group beneath company name. Give each anchor a 44px-minimum flex row, aligned icon and text with an 8–10px gap; use min-width:0 and overflow-wrap:anywhere for email, keep phone text together. Preserve mailto:yohansforex@gmail.com and tel:+251911701858.
limits: Read-only screenshot/DOM audit; no mail or dialer was launched. No claim of full accessibility compliance or domain ownership/trademark clearance.
